editorial_notes: CN primary meaning source; EN for speaker names, position and commands. Source Git blob SHA differ as localized text differs; 70 ordinal positions and all non-dialogue commands match, EN has terminal newline.

CN #10 directly says the mask means nothing to Amiya; EN softens this as 'I don't think'. RU follows CN.

CN #30 says a person's fate no longer rests solely in their own hands after Oripathy; EN 'her life is no longer her own' is narrower. RU follows CN.
CN #45 speaks of extinguishing hatred on a chain of thorns; EN speaks of casting the chains aside. RU follows CN image.
CN #54 uses masculine pronouns about the mask's owner, though surrounding context includes Misha's disguise. RU preserves the source's masculine pronoun; editorial review recommended.
CN #65 says 'that doctor', EN says 'that other doctor'; RU follows CN.
CN #68 describes even the best chess player being put in check by an accident; EN 'grandmaster' elaborates. RU follows CN.
No complete CN/EN source scripts are committed; translations are ordinal replacement strings only. No in-client validation.
